title: Wrap the inner paragraph
brief: A writer wants to quote a paragraph. Add an opening and closing quotation mark around the entire block of text.
text:
The sun set slowly.
Birds flew home.
The wind died down.

expect.text:
"The sun set slowly.
Birds flew home.
The wind died down."

why: vip visually selects the inner paragraph. I inserts before the selection, `> jumps to the end of it, and a appends after.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use vip to select the whole paragraph, then insert at both ends.
